Task: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Pasta Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Heat half of the oil in a large pot. Add in the chicken, season with half of the seasoned salt and pepper, and cook. 
Step 2: Once the chicken is nicely browned and cooked through, remove it from the pan. Set aside. 
Step 3: Add in remaining oil, onion, and broccoli. Cover for 2 minutes. Season with remaining seasoned salt and pepper. Cook and stir until the onions begin to become translucent. 
Step 4: Pour in milk and bring to a boil. Stir periodically so the bottom does not burn. 
Step 5: Once milk is bubbling, add pasta and stir frequently until pasta reaches your desired doneness (approximately 10 minutes at medium heat). 
Step 6: Add in Parmesan and mozzarella. Stir until cheese is melted. 
Step 7: Stir in chicken until well incorporated.

Task: Pack-And-Go Frittata Sandwiches Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180˚C). 
Step 2: Brush a 9x9-inch (23x23-cm) baking dish with the olive oil. 
Step 3: In a medium bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and chives. Season with salt and pepper. 
Step 4: Add the egg mixture to the baking dish and bake until just set in the middle, 15-20 minutes. Cut into 9 squares. 
Step 5: For kids, layer one slice of cheese on top of one of the English muffin halves. Top with a frittata square. Spread the remaining English muffin half with mustard, and sandwich together. 
Step 6: For adults, layer one slice of cheese on top of one of the English muffin halves. Top with a frittata square, roasted red pepper slices, and arugula. Spread the remaining English muffin half with mustard, and sandwich together.

Task: Crunchy Taco Cups Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Preheat oven to 375º F. 
Step 2: In a large skillet, brown the ground beef and drain any remaining fat. Transfer to a bowl. 
Step 3: Add taco seasoning, tomatoes and green chiles to the ground beef and stir to combine. 
Step 4: Cut flour tortillas into a square shape and cut each into 4 smaller equally sized square pieces. 
Step 5: Generously coat a standard size muffin tin with nonstick cooking spray. 
Step 6: Line each cup of prepared muffin tin with a tortilla sheet. 
Step 7: Add 1.5 tablespoons taco mixture. Top with 1 tablespoon of cheese. Press down and add another layer of tortilla sheet, taco mixture, and a final layer of cheese. 
Step 8: Lightly brush the top edges of the tortilla with cooking oil. 
Step 9: Bake 18-20 minutes until cups are heated through and edges are golden brown.

Task: Dark Chocolate Swirl Banana Bread Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: Preheat oven to 325˚F (170˚C). 
Step 2: Mash bananas in a large bowl. Add eggs and combine thoroughly. Then mix in the remaining wet ingredients: greek yogurt, maple syrup, and vanilla. 
Step 3: Next, add the whole wheat flour and baking powder and mix until fully incorporated. Be careful not to over mix. 
Step 4: In a medium, microwave-safe bowl, microwave the chocolate chunks in 30-second intervals, stirring in between, until melted and smooth. 
Step 5: Add a large scoop of the banana batter to the bowl of melted chocolate and fold until mixed well. 
Step 6: Pour the banana batter and the chocolate batter alternately into a greased 9x5-inch (23x13 cm) bread pan. These do not need to be even layers. 
Step 7: Using a knife or a spoon, gently swirl the batters together. 
Step 8: Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean from the center of the bread. 
Step 9: Allow to cool for at least 15 minutes.

Task: Chicken Fajita Quesadillas Recipe by Tasty

Step 4: Flip the quesadilla over and cook the other side until it’s golden. Remove from pan and cut into quarters. Repeat these steps with the remaining tortillas. 
Step 5: *Optional - Serve with sour cream, guacamole, and salsa. Enjoy!

Task: Chickpea Fries Recipe by Tasty

Step 2: Immediately transfer to a greased, baking dish. [We used an 8x10 (20x25 cm), but a larger one will just produce thinner fries]. Knock the dish on your work surface a few times to ensure that the mixture spreads evenly and to release any air bubbles. 
Step 3: Press plastic wrap over the mixture to ensure a flat surface and refrigerate for 2 hours until it has set firm. 
Step 4: Dipping sauce: In a medium bowl, combine greek yogurt, a pinch of salt, finely chopped parsley, finely chopped dill, clove garlic minced, and lemon juice. 
Step 5: Invert the baking dish on a cutting board (you may have to pull at the edges to release the suction for it to fall out cleanly). Slice into streak fry sizes. 
Step 6: Shallow fry in oil until each side is golden and crispy. Salt immediately after coming out of oil.

Task: Mandu
Step 1: Place the tofu in a small bowl lined with paper towels. Top with another paper towel and a bowl filled water for weight. Let sit for 15 minutes to extract some moisture from the tofu.

Step 4: Put two teaspoons of filling in the middle of a dumpling wrapper. Using your finger, wet half of the outer rim of the wrapper with the egg and water mixture.

Step 6: Bring a large pot of water to boil over high heat. Once boiling, add 6-7 mandu at a time. Once the mandu start floating on the surface, boil for another 1-2 minutes. Remove the mandu from the water with a spider or slotted spoon and repeat with the rest of the dumplings. 
Step 7: Serve with dipping sauce.

Task: Chocolate Banana Cream Sandwiches Recipe by Tasty
Step 1: In a medium mixing bowl combine the brownie mix, oil and water. Mix well. 
Step 2: On a baking sheet, lay down a sheet of wax paper. Spoon on half the mixture, and spread out to be about ½ inch (1 cm) thick. 
Step 3: Press 6 gram crackers into the mixture. Cover with remaining brownie batter. 
Step 4: Bake at 350˚F (180˚C) for 15-20 minutes until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. 
Step 5: Let it cool before slicing out the graham crackers. (There will be leftover bits of brownie in between the slices to enjoy now! Mmmm. ) 
Step 6: Freeze the rectangular slices for one hour. 
Step 7: Peel and slice 3 bananas before freezing. 
Step 8: In a blender, combine the bananas, vanilla, and maple syrup. Blend on high until creamy. 
Step 9: Use a bag to squeeze the filling onto the crust. Top with another crust.
